reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes participation in a Forsage BUSD network-marketing program through WhatsApp and presents tiered programs with income tied to direct partners and team development. Account screenshots reinforce the solicitation with personal referral links, partner and team counts, and BUSD earning figures; the frames do not establish whether the earnings were authentic or withdrawn, or whether viewers paid or lost money.

citations.quote: Contact me on WhatsApp at [PHONE] to work on the Forsage BUSD platform.

opening.argument: The supplied material does not establish a guaranteed return, a risk-free claim, or an instruction to send money. The title says only to contact the speaker "to work on" the platform, while the supplied speech contains no clear financial promise and instead includes unrelated, uncertain-sounding lines such as "Who knows how many people we made." A displayed account figure is evidence of what the screen claims, not proof that the creator deceptively guaranteed those results. The record therefore supports a cautious interpretation of an invitation to investigate a service, rather than a demonstrated scam.

citations.quote: Contact me on WhatsApp at [PHONE] to work on the Forsage BUSD platform.
Who knows how many people we made

rebuttal.rebuttal: The title does provide a contact route, but it does not say viewers must pay, that profits are guaranteed, or that losses are impossible. Likewise, the cited account screen displays claimed figures and counts, yet the prosecution concedes those figures are not verified payouts. Unverified promotional-looking material may warrant caution, but it does not by itself prove deceptive conduct.

citations.quote: Contact me on WhatsApp at [PHONE] to work on the Forsage BUSD platform.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A scam classification does not require an explicit risk-free guarantee. The title directly invites contact to work on the platform, and the account screen pairs a personal referral link with profit, partner, and team figures. Those features show recruitment-oriented promotion even if the displayed earnings are unverified.

citations.quote: Contact me on WhatsApp at [PHONE] to work on the Forsage BUSD platform.

opening.argument: The visual presentation can reasonably be read as an explainer or demonstration of how a network-marketing platform is structured. One frame defines network marketing and describes distribution of products and services, while another lays out multiple program levels with diagrams. Showing how a system is organized is not the same as certifying that every earnings claim is true or directing a viewer to commit funds. The supplied speech also does not provide a clear spoken sales pitch or financial instruction, leaving the educational-demonstration reading plausible.

citations.quote: Do what you want, with the help of government

rebuttal.rebuttal: The presence of diagrams and account screens does not eliminate an instructional purpose. A tutorial about a platform would naturally show its levels, interface, links, and example metrics. The prosecution identifies promotional implications, but it does not point to a spoken command to pay or a verified claim that the examples are guaranteed results.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The material is not merely technical instruction. The overview specifically presents tiered programs tied to direct partners and team development, while the account screens display personal links alongside earnings and team counts. Those elements turn the demonstration into an income-opportunity solicitation, regardless of whether the narration is clear.

opening.argument: The most concrete text describes working on a platform, and the visual overview characterizes network marketing as distributing products and services. That is compatible with ordinary business or referral promotion. The supplied material does not show a deposit request, a payment transaction, a credential request, or a guaranteed return; the account panels show links and claimed balances, but not how money entered the system or whether anyone was harmed. Without evidence of that core mechanism, the judge should not convert a business opportunity into a scam finding solely because it uses partner and team terminology.

citations.quote: to work on the Forsage BUSD platform.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's own description leaves the key mechanism unproven: it acknowledges that the screens do not establish authentic or withdrawn earnings and do not show viewers paying or losing money. Partner and team counts can also occur in legitimate referral businesses. The evidence therefore supports, at most, an income-related promotion whose underlying transactions are not demonstrated.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing payment screenshot does not make the promotion ordinary. The one-page overview depicts successive programs based on direct partners and team growth, and the account panels place personal referral links next to profit and team metrics. That combination supplies the recruitment structure even if individual deposits or losses are not visible.
